notes.title: We are replacing Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Some of you told us that the images we used in the game could have been obtained without the corresponding copyright. We always look for images with all the permissions that will be used in our projects, but even if the source of the images assures us that they can be used, this is not always the case.

In this case, we could not verify that they were shared with a corresponding license, and it is possible that who had loaded them did not have the rights to do so.

For this reason, we have decided to remove the game from the Steam store and have uploaded Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime Reloaded,with new images of which we are sure we have all the corresponding rights for its use.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1024490/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Anime_Reloaded/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1024490/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Anime_Reloaded/[/url]


We apologize for any inconvenience.


Cheers!

notes.title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/972430/ss_dd71c6dbf014cb5737e7c0060f8cdca46bce93f5.1920x1080.jpg?t=1542059863[/img]

Hi guys! We are happy to announce the release of our new special game of the Super jigsaw Puzzle series, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime! 

Make puzzles of beautiful anime images! Kawaii! 30 puzzles in 5 difficulties, now with rotation and puzzles up to 800 pieces! And just for the launch we have a 40% discount!

And remember that you can buy all the games in a bundle with an additional 30% discount, even if you have the other games already!

[h1]Just relax and make puzzles![/h1]
